# SpiceHub

> A zero-cost, offline-first meal and recipe planner (PWA). Its distinguishing
> feature is social-media recipe import: paste or share an Instagram, TikTok,
> Pinterest or recipe-blog link and it extracts a structured recipe —
> ingredients, steps, timings, photo — without manual retyping.

SpiceHub runs entirely on the device. Recipes, the weekly plan, the grocery
list and the bar/pantry inventory live in IndexedDB (Dexie), and the app is
fully usable with no network. Import is the only feature that needs one, and
requests made while offline are queued and drained when connectivity returns.

## What it does

- **Weekly planner** — assign meals to days, spin for suggestions, respin a
  single day, lock the ones you have decided on, generate a grocery list from
  the week.
- **Recipe import** — from a URL, a shared link, pasted text, or photos of a
  cookbook page. Structured extraction with a confidence signal and a review
  step before anything is saved.
- **Meal and drink libraries** — tags, favourites, ratings, cook history.
- **Pantry and bar** — track what is in stock and see which recipes are
  already cookable.
- **Cook Mode / Mix Mode** — step-by-step, screen-awake walkthroughs with
  scaling and timers.

## Privacy

Recipe and plan data is stored locally and is not uploaded anywhere by
default. Import sends the shared URL or text to third-party structuring
services (Google Gemini among them) purely to turn prose into fields; the
current terms are shown in-app before first use and are the authoritative
statement. Optional account features (friends, shared household plans) are
opt-in and off unless configured.

## Notes for automated agents

- Single-route SPA. Every screen is client-side state under `/`; there are no
  server-rendered sub-pages to crawl. See `/sitemap.xml`.
- `/api/*` are the app's own serverless endpoints, not a public API. They are
  not documented, not versioned, and not intended for third-party use.
- There is no public data set here to index — content is whatever an
  individual user has saved on their own device.
